annotations.title: Exchange coverage: OI, volume, funding and pegs across every exchange we snapshot

description: Call this when the user asks about total open interest across exchanges, which venues hold the most OI, DEX versus CEX share, funding dispersion between venues, or stablecoin pegs. Returns the latest 10-minute snapshot aggregates across every perpetual and spot feed we poll (the coverage field lists them); pass symbol for one coin's per-venue rows. Without symbol, rows holds the 30 venue markets with the largest open interest; pass symbol, or limit (up to 250) for more. Pass detail "compact" for a shorter page or "full" for the whole answer.

detail.description: Optional. "compact": a shorter page than the default (fewer rows, newest points kept, rounded figures, long text cut, grids left out; every cut named in trimmed). "full" or true: the whole route answer, still under the 100,000 character ceiling (the largest boards answer the ceiling note then: narrow them with symbol, limit or days instead). Omitted or false: the default first page.

history_days.description: Return the hourly multi-venue open interest history (total, DEX share, OI-weighted funding) for this many days instead of the snapshot

limit.description: Optional. Venue market rows without symbol, largest open interest first (default 30).

symbol.description: string, optional base asset, e.g. BTC

name: get_venue_markets
